note: DRAFT for review. Raw category labels that match no taxonomy key, name or synonym, each mapped to ONE existing taxonomy key where the meaning is clear. A label is looked up by its normalised form (lower case, accents stripped, non-alphanumerics to '-'), so 'Juice' and 'juice' are one entry. Product counts are Canadian catalogue rows from the 2026-10-08 sample of the 30 commonest unresolved labels (15,211 products carry an unresolved label, 3,672 distinct labels; this file covers the top 30 by count, 8,847 products). Labels left out of 'aliases' are listed in 'unmapped' with the reason; they stay unresolved and are counted by every rebuild. Every target was checked to be a key of the 2026-10-08 taxonomy; a target missing from the taxonomy stops the load.

Autre boisson non-alcoolisée.reason: French for 'other non-alcoholic beverage'; the taxonomy entry is exactly non-alcoholic beverages.

en:ground-beef.reason: Ground beef; the taxonomy's entry for it is 'ground beef meats' (parents beef and ground meats).

en:lean-ground-beef.reason: Lean ground beef is ground beef; the taxonomy has no lean-specific entry, so it maps to the entry that contains it.

Bière, boisson à base de malt.reason: French for 'beer, malt-based beverage'; beer is the malt-based alcoholic beverage.

Juice.reason: The taxonomy's entry for juice in general is 'juices and nectars'.

Jus.reason: French for juice; same entry as 'Juice'.

Eau, eau gazéifiée.reason: French for 'water, carbonated water'; both are waters.

en:whole-wheat-bread.reason: Whole wheat bread is wholemeal bread.

en:large-eggs.reason: Large eggs are eggs; the taxonomy has no size-specific entry, so it maps to the entry that contains them.

en:chocolate-chips.reason: Chocolate chips are chocolate drops (baking pieces); the taxonomy's entry is 'chocolate drops'.

Soft Drink.reason: Singular of the taxonomy entry 'soft drinks'.
